name: a store that refuses a write answers ERR_INDEX_FAILED
description: 502 rather than 500: the store this service talks to misbehaved, not this service. A 500 here sends whoever is debugging to the wrong logs. The code is specific rather than shared because Phorge's bin/search reindex reports a write failure somewhere quite different from a query failure — collapsing them would leave an operator with "the search service returned 502" and nothing else.
